lyrics:
[Intro: slow arpeggiated electric guitar chords, bass]

[Verse 1: low, bluesy, guitar and bass]
There is a little house of light
It fits inside my hand
It's been the end of many a day
And many a thing I planned

[Verse 2: organ enters, drums soft]
My mother kept a garden
She grew her beans in rows
My father was a talking man
He knew what a neighbour knows

[Verse 3: voice rising, organ swirling]
Now all a body needs to live
Is a charger and a chair
And the only time he's satisfied
Is when he isn't there

[Organ Solo: swirling, building, drums louder]

[Verse 4: howled, full band]
So tell the little ones for me
To lift their eyes and run
Out to the yard and the daylight
While there's still a sun

[Verse 5: loud, desperate]
I've one foot on the doorstep
The other in the glow
I only meant to check the time
That was hours ago

[Verse 6: quieter, the first verse again]
There is a little house of light
It fits inside my hand
It's been the end of many a day
And Lord, I know I'm damned

[Outro: organ and guitar, slowing, final chord]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 117 BPM counted in six, so it rolls, in A minor. A slow-burning blues ballad that swells from a murmur to a howl and back.

VOICE: Male baritone with a deep, rough, bluesy tone and a Newcastle edge, sounding much older than his years. He begins low and restrained, howls verses 4 and 5 at the top of his voice, and drops back for the last.

INSTRUMENTS: An electric guitar playing each chord as a slow, even arpeggio, the song's signature. An electric organ with a thin, reedy tone that starts as a hum and builds to a swirling solo. Electric bass. A drum kit that grows from soft cymbals to a heavy beat. Nothing else.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, guitar arpeggios. 0:12 Verse 1. 0:36 Verse 2, organ. 1:00 Verse 3, rising. 1:24 Organ solo. 1:54 Verse 4, howled. 2:18 Verse 5. 2:42 Verse 6, quieter. 3:06 Outro, organ and guitar slowing to a final chord at 3:25.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Mid-1960s British rhythm and blues recorded in one take: raw, mono and close, organ and voice fighting for the front.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The guitar arpeggio in the first four seconds.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The house of ruin is in everyone's pocket now, and the warning is to children. The verse about the mother's garden and the father who knew his neighbours is the world the house replaced.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Confession, warning, relapse.
